correctness.rationale: For every m>=2 and every cyclic window 1<=b<=2^m, incidence counting over all nonzero affine words forces a universal bound d_b<=2^m-2^{m-b} for b<=m. The trace basis 1,g,...,g^(m-1) on primitive nonzero field powers has every b-tuple t or t-1 times; inserting coordinate zero increases any all-zero window count by at most one. The minimal-polynomial recurrence p(1)=1 excludes m+1 zero-runs in complemented words. This proves simultaneous attainment and full distance at b>=m+1. Independent direct enumeration of affine words and b-window distances for m=2..5 matched; finite tests are corroboration, not the unbounded proof.
